summary: Phase 149O.6 -- HATP Class-B Deployment + Activation Implementation (Wave 7): closed the AG3/AG5 Permission Broker wiring gap HATP-REQ-105/106 identified as the remaining prerequisite for B-149O-1..4 system-level closure. Replaced Wave 4's hardcoded provider_profile_available=False/provider_attestation_trusted=False/assert operational is False activation ceiling in inspect_hatp_verification_substrate_readiness with real derivations from Wave-5 hardware-provider discovery (hatp_providers.discover_hardware_providers) and capability inspection (create_production_hardware_provider(...).capabilities().hatp_conformant); added HATPVerificationSubstrateStatus.OPERATIONAL, genuinely reachable under a synthetic Class-B deployment (test_synthetic_full_class_b_reaches_operational) while remaining mechanically NOT_READY on this real, same-principal, no-hardware deployment; independently confirmed via a parametrized one-term-removed matrix that no single term is redundant. New module pcae.core.hatp_ag_authority: the AG3/AG5 production authority adapter the Wave-6 gated derivation's own docstring named but did not construct. Its two public entry points (resolve_ag3_gated_rollback_authority, resolve_ag5_gated_rollback_authority) resolve every HATP dependency exclusively via the Wave-5/Wave-2 production factories (HATPTrustStore.production(), hatp_providers.create_production_hardware_provider) -- accepting no hatp_provider/hatp_trust_store parameter at all, closing Finding F-2 (149O.5) structurally rather than via a runtime isinstance check that a structural typing.Protocol cannot reliably enforce -- consume only the Wave-6 gated derivation (never the legacy narrow API, confirmed by source-text guard), and construct/evaluate a PermissionBrokerRequest through the real, unmodified PermissionBroker policy engine with approval_present sourced exclusively from the just-derived gated fact. execute_rollback (AG3) and build_rollback_execution (AG5) in agent.py each gain three new optional, keyword-only parameters (hatp_evidence_id, hatp_proof, hatp_evidence) defaulting to None; omitting them (every pre-Wave-7 caller, and every CLI command today, since no CLI flag yet supplies them) leaves behavior byte-identical, confirmed by the full pre-existing AG3/AG5 regression suite plus a dedicated new test that monkeypatches the adapter to raise if invoked. When supplied, the derived approval fact and PB decision are attached to the return value under a new hatp_authority key for governance/audit visibility, without themselves gating the real git-revert/file-restore dispatch -- a deliberate, explicitly-documented scope boundary, not an oversight: Permission Broker's own module docstring states its implementation status is execution_unavailable system-wide (no COMP-002 execution boundary exists anywhere in PCAE), and no CLI/signing-ceremony surface exists yet through which a human could responsibly supply real HATP evidence without inventing an unreviewed ad hoc format. A fresh, independently-authored test suite (tests/test_phase_149o_6_hatp_wave7_class_b_deployment_activation.py, 26 passed) drives a genuine RAE+HATP chain through the actual resolve_ag3_gated_rollback_authority production entry point (not the lower-level Wave-6 function directly), with production factories monkeypatched to a controlled synthetic deployment, and reproduces all four historical B-149O-1..4 attacks (unenrolled signer, mutated Binding digest, fresh unregistered key, genuine-RAE-chain-with-no-HATP-proof) -- all blocked (approval_present=False) -- plus confirms HATP VALID with no active task still yields PB DENY (never ALLOW), and missing approval yields HUMAN_REVIEW (POL-004), never a hardcoded HATP-status-to-decision mapping. B-149O-1..4 move to REPAIRED AT SYSTEM IMPLEMENTATION LEVEL, PENDING INDEPENDENT WAVE-7 VERIFICATION -- not self-closed, per the governing brief's own instruction. Ten pre-existing boundary tests across seven files (test_hatp_verification_engine.py, test_phase_149o_1j_..., test_phase_149o_4_..., test_phase_149o_5_..., test_phase_149j_..., test_phase_149m_..., test_phase_148f_..., test_phase_149o_1g_...) were narrowly updated with documented justification because they encoded Wave-4/5/6-and-earlier invariants (single-member status enum, hardcoded assert in source, zero production consumers of the RAE/PB APIs outside specific named files, literal single-line function signatures) that Wave 7 intentionally supersedes by design; no broad guard assertion was weakened, and one further pre-existing, wholly unrelated false positive (hatp_bootstrap.py's own module docstring naming permission_broker_foundation.py in prose describing what it deliberately does not import, tripping a PB-consumer-scope grep) was also fixed, independently confirmed present on a clean git stash before any Wave-7 change. Five additional pre-existing test failures (a RAE freshness/staleness bug in test_rae_stale_plus_valid_hatp_still_false, and four RAE-001 registration-key-binding forgery findings in test_phase_149o_rollback_approval_evidence_canonical_provenance_hardening_independent_verification.py, plus the already-documented F-3 byte-freeze boundary test) were independently reproduced as present on a clean git stash and confirmed unrelated to and unaffected by this phase's changes; none was fixed, per the governing brief's instruction not to repair unrelated debt in an implementation phase. Fast Green: 4590 passed, 2 skipped, 0 failed -- exact match to the 149O.5 baseline, confirming no collateral regression. Report-trust: 187 passed -- exact match. HATP-001 v1.0 confirmed byte-unchanged. HATP production remains NOT READY on this deployment (same-principal, no hardware provider attached). Runtime remains Observed / observe / unavailable, confirmed before and after. Full detail in docs/PHASE_149O_6_HATP_CLASS_B_DEPLOYMENT_ACTIVATION_IMPLEMENTATION.md. Recommended next phase: 149O.7, HATP Class-B Deployment / Activation Independent Verification.
